raw_response:
Aiya, let me think through this year's plan. I'm getting old — 75 now — but the land still needs to be worked. My wife and I manage these 5.2 mu together, same as we've done for decades. The wheat-maize rotation is what everyone here does, and it's what I know.

**About the wheat first** — I planted it last October, around the 10th, like always. Right now it's already past the green-up stage and heading into jointing. Before planting, I put down a compound fertilizer (15-15-15) at about 40 kg/mu as base, which is roughly 6 kg N/mu in the base. That's the way the extension station taught us years ago — base fertilizer plus topdress. In the next two weeks I'll topdress with urea, about 25-30 kg/mu of urea, which gives me another 12-13 kg N/mu. So altogether around 18-19 kg N/mu for the season. Some of the younger farmers nearby use less now, they say the soil already has enough, but I'd rather be safe — at my age I can't afford a bad year.

I'll need to irrigate with the well water. Already did the green-up watering in March. I'll water again at jointing (this month), then once at heading, and one more before harvest if it stays dry. Three times total, probably. Each time costs me about 35-40 yuan/mu in electricity for the well. The well is shared with neighbors so you have to wait your turn.

For pests, I'll spray once for aphids around heading time, and add a fungicide for stripe rust because it's been bad some years. Cheap insurance.

I expect maybe 420-450 kg/mu of wheat — last year I got 430. Not bad for old land.

**Then maize** — the moment the wheat combine leaves the field in mid-June, I have to move fast. Maybe 5-7 days to get the maize in. I don't own a planter, so I hire the custom no-till planter operator from the village — costs me about 25 yuan/mu but saves my back. He plants right into the wheat stubble with the seed and starter fertilizer at the same time.

I use Zhengdan 958 or whatever hybrid seed the agro-shop has that year — about 4 kg/mu of seed, costs around 60 yuan/mu. The starter fertilizer is compound at maybe 30 kg/mu. Then around the V6-V8 stage in mid-July, I topdress urea, about 25-30 kg/mu. Total N for maize is around 16-17 kg/mu. I do less than wheat because maize seems to need less here, and the residue from wheat helps.

Irrigation for maize — depends on the rainy season. If July rains come on time, maybe just one watering at tasseling. If it's dry, two waterings. Last summer was dry so I had to water twice.

For pests, maize borer is the big worry — I spray once with chlorantraniliprole around the whorl stage. Herbicide goes down right after planting (atrazine + acetochlor mix), one shot. I expect 480-520 kg/mu of maize.

**Labor** — my wife and I do most things ourselves, but for wheat harvest I hire the combine (about 60 yuan/mu), and the maize planter and harvester are also custom-hired. I can't swing a hoe like I used to. My son sends money sometimes which helps when I need to buy fertilizer up front.
